_note: The Recess shelf (docs/GAMES.md). One row per game, in shelf order. band: k2, 35, 68, 912 or all (the colored edge). live turns the box into a link. Art is site/templates/recess/art-<id>.svg.

games.title: Go
games.blurb: Surround more of the board than your rival. Stones click down; captured groups wash away like ink.

games.title: Chess
games.blurb: A paper theatre lit from the side. Play the computer, a friend, or a quick mate-in-one.

games.title: Checkers
games.blurb: Neon pucks on a glowing grid. Chain your jumps and pop a crown.

games.title: Cargo Hold
games.blurb: Slide the crates to free the hatch. Fewest moves wins the stars.

games.title: Untangle
games.blurb: Drag the stars until no lines cross, and watch the constellation light up.
